findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "recon_execute" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Execute a quoted intelligence deliverable (quote_id, approve=true). Atomically holds Audit Credits up to the quoted ceiling, runs sync or queues async audit wor…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
